info.title: Pathology Network API
info.description: Pathology Network Platform API v1. Errors use { error: { code, message, status, details } }; lists use { data, pagination: { next_cursor, limit } }.

post.summary: POST /abha-verifications: OTP to the ABHA's mobile
POST /abha-enrolments: Aadhaar OTP, after recording consent
POST /payment-links: a gateway link for the balance, sent to the patient
POST /payments/{payment}/refunds. The payment is reached through a visible invoice
Add-on tests: answers with the supplementary invoice

wallet_check.description: Filled in Phase 6, when franchise wallets exist.

get.summary: GET /patients?q=… : search is required, the patient list is never browsable
A merged record answers with the record that survived (spec §7.3)
A region with its direct children, so clients can walk the tree

AbhaStatus.description: ABHA link state on a patient (spec §5.7).
AbhaStatus.title: AbhaStatus

AddOrderItemsRequest.description: POST /orders/{id}/items: add-on tests with their own invoice.
AddOrderItemsRequest.title: AddOrderItemsRequest

BranchRequest.description:
Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a branch. Code and ownership
are set once at creation.
BranchRequest.title: BranchRequest

CapabilitiesRequest.description: The complete set of tests a lab can run (PUT replaces all).
CapabilitiesRequest.title: CapabilitiesRequest

HomeCollectionStatusRequest.description: Status updates from the phlebotomist app, with GPS on collection (spec §5.3).
HomeCollectionStatusRequest.title: HomeCollectionStatusRequest

InvoicePaymentStatus.description: credit: billed to a B2B client on credit terms.
InvoicePaymentStatus.title: InvoicePaymentStatus

LabTestRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a test. The code is fixed at creation.
LabTestRequest.title: LabTestRequest

PatientRequest.description:
Register (POST) or correct (PATCH) a patient. Registration records the
consent notice shown (spec §10 DPDP); either a date of birth or an age is
required.
PatientRequest.title: PatientRequest

PriceListItemsRequest.description: The complete set of prices for a list (PUT replaces all items).
PriceListItemsRequest.title: PriceListItemsRequest

PriceListRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH). The list type is fixed at creation.
PriceListRequest.title: PriceListRequest

PriceListType.description: mrp: what patients pay. partner: what HQ charges a franchise. client: what HQ charges a B2B client (spec §7.4).
PriceListType.title: PriceListType

RegionRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a region.
RegionRequest.title: RegionRequest

ReportDelivery.description: How a referring doctor receives reports (spec §7.3).
ReportDelivery.title: ReportDelivery

RoleRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a custom role. Scope level is fixed at creation.
RoleRequest.title: RoleRequest

RoutingRuleRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH). The source branch is fixed at creation.
RoutingRuleRequest.title: RoutingRuleRequest

ScopeLevel.description: How much of the network a role can see (spec §4, roles.scope_level).
ScopeLevel.title: ScopeLevel

SigningDiscipline.description: Which qualification may sign a department's results (spec §7.2, §10).
SigningDiscipline.title: SigningDiscipline

TestParameterRequest.description:
A parameter and, optionally, its full set of reference ranges. Option
parameters need their options; calculated ones need a formula.
TestParameterRequest.title: TestParameterRequest

UserRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a staff member.
UserRequest.title: UserRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
